attribution.localizedCause: File-backed predictor pages plus package preprocessing and finalization page cache exhausted the 9,999,998,976-byte effective cgroup cap; process-tree RSS alone peaked at 7,395,300 KiB and therefore did not expose the cgroup charge.

decision.rationale: Preserve q1 as failed evidence and authorize one correction-only successor that reduces cgroup file-cache pressure while keeping model probabilities, package inputs, corpus, and accounting unchanged.

hypothesis.rationale: The run conclusively failed its resource precondition at maximum_cgroup_memory_peak_bytes=9999998976, but archive identity and exact inversion were not measured because no encode-stage receipt or decode was produced.

transferableLessons: Full-corpus memory safety must control cgroup-charged file cache during package finalization, not only mapped predictor RSS; opening and distant 10M evidence was insufficient for that phase transition.
uncertainties: The exact split between dirty mapped FXCM/PPM pages and preprocessing or archive page cache was not sampled in memory.stat, so the correction must remain resource-only and be retested under the same cap.

reasons: The bound full-1G Arm A executed on the canonical corpus, but encode finalization reached the effective cgroup-v2 memory.max and the guard terminated it before an encode-stage receipt or decode.
